intent.proves: Data models per product family: products-without-model satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''{inScope} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomGroupProductRelation r JOIN EcomGroups g ON g.GroupId = r.GroupProductRelationGroupId AND g.GroupType IN (2, 3) WHERE r.GroupProductRelationProductId = p.ProductId)
